governance: analytical private; no public release authorized

fact_inah_visits_monthly.grain: individual INAH reception site and calendar month
fact_inah_visits_monthly.unit: registered entries; explicit zero is a reported count
fact_inah_visits_monthly.lineage: Big Data 02 Parquet checked against its own binary manifest
fact_inah_visits_monthly.use: calendar description; no unique tourists, capacity or causal effects

fact_datatur_occupancy_monthly.grain: DataTur selected hotel center and calendar month
fact_datatur_occupancy_monthly.vintage: contemporary preliminary monthly XLSX; later editions retained in silver_datatur_vintages
fact_datatur_occupancy_monthly.denominator: available rooms per day monthly average in the same center-month
fact_datatur_occupancy_monthly.aggregation: no sum of percentages; room-nights require validated coverage and methodology

calendar: period-only alignment; indicators in separate columns; do not cross-aggregate

uca_transfer.storage: raw manifests, lineage, quality and canonical hashes
uca_transfer.mining: EDA within same unit, entity and compatible windows
uca_transfer.ml: temporal splits, original vintage, validate coverage and targets
uca_transfer.stochastic: reported zeros, discontinuities and observed vintage comparisons
uca_transfer.operations: calendar context; capacities, costs and access require independent confirmation
uca_transfer.marketing: formulate hypotheses and verify operating conditions before campaign
